confidence_notes: I based the food, coffee and beer anchors on one web search. It returned crowdsourced cost-of-living figures from MyLifeElsewhere, which put an inexpensive meal at about USD 4.6-5.5, a cappuccino at about USD 1.9-2.4 and a domestic beer at about USD 3.5-4.0. I raised the meal and coffee figures slightly to allow for central and tourist areas. The mid-range meal is my own estimate, set relative to the inexpensive meal. Cocktail and wine are also my estimates, based on how they usually compare with beer prices in Morocco, where alcohol is expensive and served mainly in licensed venues. All four accommodation anchors are general-knowledge estimates for July 2026, which is summer peak season. I did not check booking pages or listings. Casablanca has only a few registered hostels, so the hostel anchors are especially uncertain.
comparable_city_reasoning: I compared Casablanca with Rabat, Marrakech and Tangier. As a commercial hub, Casablanca usually costs more than the Moroccan average for eating out, and the search source put it about 32% above the national average. Its hostel supply is thinner than Marrakech's.
